meta.name: histolab
meta.description: Lightweight WSI tile extraction and preprocessing. Use for basic slide processing, tissue detection, tile extraction, and stain normalization for H&E images. Best for simple pipelines, dataset preparation, and quick tile-based analysis. For advanced spatial proteomics, multiplexed imaging, or deep learning pipelines use pathml.

copy.tagline: 从病理切片中提取组织块并预处理图像
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果经常需要处理H&E染色切片并提取组织块用于下游分析
copy.tagline_en: Extract tissue tiles from pathology slides and preprocess images
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you frequently work with H&E stained slides and need to extract tissue tiles for downstream analysis

howto.what: 装上 histolab 后，Claude 可以处理数字病理学的全切片图像（WSI），包括加载 SVS 等格式、自动检测组织区域、按随机/网格/评分策略提取图块，以及进行染色归一化等预处理。
howto.when: 当你提到处理全切片图像、提取组织图块、进行染色归一化等数字病理学任务时，或直接要求运行 histolab 的某个函数时触发。

say.text: 帮我用 histolab 提取这个 SVS 文件的图块。
say.note: 将执行随机提取 100 个 512x512 图块。

say.text: 对这个 WSI 做组织检测和网格图块提取。
say.note: 使用 GridTiler 进行全覆盖提取。

say.text: 用 histolab 对两个切片做染色归一化。
say.note: 使用 Macenko 或 Reinhard 方法。

howto.what_en: With histolab installed, Claude can process whole slide images (WSI) in digital pathology: load SVS/TIFF/NDPI formats, automatically detect tissue regions, extract tiles using random/grid/score strategies, and perform stain normalization. It prepares datasets for deep learning pipelines.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you mention processing whole slide images (WSI), extracting tissue tiles, stain normalization, or any digital pathology task; or directly request a histolab function.

say_en.text: Extract tiles from this SVS file using histolab.
Perform tissue detection and grid tile extraction on this WSI.
Normalize the staining between two slides with histolab.
